title: Google Business Profile
description: Manage online presence, reviews, opening hours and photos of physical stores.

home.description: The Google profiles of each unit, with the analyses and the agent's automation.
home.managed: Your company is managed by the partner: they take care of the profiles and you follow along here.
home.emptyDescription: Connect the Google profile of a unit to get started.

window.title: Add location
window.subtitle: Connect a Google profile to the workspace {workspace}.

connect.title: Sign in with the profile's Google account
connect.description: Use the account that manages the profile on Google. Then you choose which profile to connect.
connect.readOnly: At this step the agent only reads and suggests: nothing changes on the profile.
connect.oneAtATime: One profile at a time. For another unit, run Add location again.
connect.notConfigured: The Google connection is not configured in this environment yet.

permissions.title: Google permissions are missing
permissions.description: Without them the agent cannot read the profile. See what each one is for.

manage_profile.title: Manage your Google profile
manage_profile.why: To read the profile and the reviews and prepare suggestions. Changing anything on the profile always depends on your permission.

account_identity.title: See your name and e-mail
account_identity.why: To show which Google account is connected.

permissions.promise: The agent does not delete the profile and changes nothing without your permission.

denied.title: Connection canceled
denied.description: The Google account was not connected. You can try again whenever you want.

failed.title: Could not connect
failed.description: Google did not complete the connection. Try again.

choose.title: Choose the profile
choose.description: These are the profiles the account manages. Choose one.
choose.expired: The Google connection expired. Sign in again.

analyze.title: Reading and analyzing the profile
analyze.description: Each step is marked when it ends.

unit.title: A unit with this address already exists
unit.description: Link the profile to it so the unit is not duplicated, or create a new one.

ready.title: {count, plural, =0 {No points to validate} one {We found # point to validate} other {We found # points to validate}}
ready.description: Review each area on the automation page.
ready.background: Other analyses keep running in the background. We will let you know in the bell when they finish.

automation.suggestOnly: Only suggests until the first review
automation.points: {count, plural, =0 {No points to validate} one {# point to validate} other {# points to validate}}
automation.lock: Until someone approves every area for the first time, the agent only suggests, even in areas set to automatic.

autonomy.title: How the agent acts in this area
autonomy.description: You can change it any time.

auto.title: Trust the agent (automatic)
auto.description: The agent applies on its own what is within the rules.

approval.title: Review and approve first
approval.description: The agent prepares and you approve each change before it goes to the profile.

autonomy.aboveCeiling: Automatic is not allowed for you.

tips.title: Tips from the analyses
tips.description: What the analyses found in this area. Nothing was changed on the profile.

noTips.title: No tips in this area
noTips.description: The analyses found no points to validate here.

insights.title: Other analyses
insights.description: Results that do not depend on a setting.
insights.running: Running. The result shows here when it ends.
insights.failed: This analysis did not finish. It will be tried again.

saved.reviewed: Page reviewed: the agent may now act according to each area's autonomy.

agent.title: Google agent
agent.description: Answers questions about the profile and the areas. Changes nothing.
agent.emptyDescription: For example: what changes if I set reviews to automatic?
agent.label: Your question
agent.notice: The agent answers based on the profile and the analyses. In this conversation it changes nothing.

reviews.name: Reviews
reviews.description: Replies to reviews in your brand's tone, takes negative ones to a person on the team and prepares review requests, always the same request for everyone.

defense.name: Profile defense
defense.description: Keeps the approved version of the profile and warns when someone, or Google itself, changes the phone, address, website, name, category or hours.

info.name: Information
info.description: Takes care of the profile's description, categories, attributes and services, from the data you already have in GUIDU.

hours.name: Hours
hours.description: Keeps the hours equal to the unit's and reminds you of holidays before they come.

posts.name: Posts
posts.description: Writes posts about news, offers and events with what you already have in the Portfolio.

photos.name: Photos
photos.description: Publishes the photos you send little by little, with a description. Never uses AI-generated images.

primary-category.title: No primary category
primary-category.detail: The primary category tells Google which searches the profile shows in.

additional-categories.title: No additional categories
additional-categories.detail: Additional categories help you show in searches related to what you do.

description-missing.title: Profile without a description
description-missing.detail: A good description explains what you do, for whom and where.

description-short.title: Short description
description-short.detail: The description has {length} characters; under {min} it says little about the business.

description-link.title: Link in the description
description-link.detail: Google does not allow links in the description; they may get the change rejected.

phone-missing.title: No phone
phone-missing.detail: Without a phone, whoever finds the profile cannot call.

website-missing.title: No website
website-missing.detail: The website link takes searchers to you.

attributes-missing.title: No attributes
attributes-missing.detail: Attributes such as accessibility and payment methods answer questions before the visit.

regular-hours-missing.title: No opening hours
regular-hours-missing.detail: Without hours, Google does not show whether you are open.

holidays-missing.title: Holiday without special hours
holidays-missing.detail: {count, plural, one {# national holiday} other {# national holidays}} in the next 45 days without special hours; the next one is on {date}.

photos-few.title: Few photos
photos-few.detail: The profile has {count} photos; we recommend at least {min}.

logo-missing.title: No logo
logo-missing.detail: The logo helps people recognize the brand in search.

cover-missing.title: No cover photo
cover-missing.detail: The cover is the first image shown on the profile.

reviews-unanswered.title: Unanswered reviews
reviews-unanswered.detail: {count, plural, one {# review} other {# reviews}} without a reply, {negative} of them with 1 or 2 stars.

reviews-response-rate.title: Low response rate
reviews-response-rate.detail: You replied to {rate}% of the reviews read; at least {target}% is recommended.

errors.provider: Google did not answer now. Try again.
errors.notConfigured: The Google connection is not configured yet.
errors.alreadyLinked: This profile is already linked to a unit.
errors.unitTaken: This unit already has a profile.
errors.invalidUnit: The profile data does not make a valid unit.
errors.aboveCeiling: This autonomy is above the limit set for you.
errors.connectionExpired: The Google connection expired. Sign in again.
errors.specialistUnavailable: The agent does not have an AI key and model yet.
errors.specialistFailed: The agent could not answer now. Try again.
